conventions.statement: When the underlying complex number of the lattice element equals l₀, the summand is 0 (the l₀-th term is omitted).
conventions.note: This is the exclusion device; the full sum over l then skips the l₀ term.

conventions.statement: When i = 0 and l.1 ≠ l₀, the summand equals (l.1 − x)^(−2 : ℤ) − l.1^(−2 : ℤ), incorporating the Weierstrass normalization subtraction.
conventions.note: The correction term l.1^(−2) is the standard ℘-normalization for the constant coefficient.

conventions.statement: When i ≥ 1 and l.1 ≠ l₀, the summand equals (i + 1) · (l.1 − x)^(−(i+2) : ℤ) with no subtracted correction term.
conventions.note: The casesOn on i removes the correction for all positive indices.

conventions.point: l.1 = x (lattice point equals expansion base-point)
conventions.statement: The factor (l.1 − x)^(−(i+2) : ℤ) becomes 0^(negative integer), which Mathlib's zpow junk-value convention evaluates to 0.
conventions.note: No error is raised; the function returns a junk value of 0 in this degenerate case.

facts.statement: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ x : ℂ) (l : ↥L.lattice), (l : ℂ) ≠ l₀ → VTask.weierstrassPExceptSummand L l₀ x 0 l = ((l : ℂ) - x) ^ (-2 : ℤ) - (l : ℂ) ^ (-2 : ℤ)

facts.statement: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ x : ℂ) (i : ℕ) (l : ↥L.lattice), VTask.weierstrassPExceptSummand L l₀ x i l ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℂ)
